newsitem.title: USA: PIMCO in talks for Oppenheimer Capital.
newsitem.headline: PIMCO in talks for Oppenheimer Capital.

text.p: PIMCO Advisors LP said it is talks to acquire Oppenheimer Financial Corp's 33 percent managing general partner interest in Oppenheimer Capital and its one percent general partner interest in Oppenheimer Capital LP.
Oppenheimer Financial is a subsidiary of Oppenheimer Group Inc.
The remaining 99 percent of Oppenheimer Capital LP would continue to be held publicly and Oppenheimer Capital LP would continue to own the remaining 67 percent of Oppenheimer Capital, PIMCO said.
Oppenheimer Capital is one of the nation's leading investment management firms, with more than $48 billion in assets under management.
PIMCO is a leading investment management organization with more than $110 billion in assets under management.
